mapper.sql: select purchase_id, purchase_no, product_id, product_name, spec, supplier_id, supplier_name, qty, purchase_price, amount, purchase_time, status, create_by, create_time, remark from pms_purchase
mapper.select: select max(purchase_no) from pms_purchase where purchase_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into pms_purchase (purchase_no, product_id, product_name, spec, supplier_id, supplier_name, qty, purchase_price, amount, purchase_time, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{purchaseNo}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{spec}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{qty}, #{purchasePrice}, #{amount}, #{purchaseTime}, ifnull(#{status}, '0'), #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update pms_purchase set status = #{status} where purchase_id = #{purchaseId}
